other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam
Applicant's parent must be engaged in building and other construction work
Applicant's parent must be registered with the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Parent must have an active membership with the Board
Applicant must have obtained a minimum of 55% in HSLC, AHM, and H.S. examinations
benefits_summary: Cash awards of ₹5,000, ₹4,000 or ₹3,500 are given to three male and three female children per district based on exam scores.
